sentences.text: It was a quiet afternoon in the market square.
sentences.textCn: 集市广场上，那是一个宁静的午后。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Then a sharp cry broke the silence.
sentences.textCn: 接着，一声尖叫打破了沉默。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A small white dog ran out from behind a stall and bit a carpenter's finger.
sentences.textCn: 一只小白狗从摊位后面跑出来，咬住了一个木匠的手指。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The carpenter held up his bleeding finger and cried, "Look what that dog did to me!"
sentences.textCn: 木匠举起流血的手指，喊道：“看看那只狗对我做了什么！”
sentences.speaker: carpenter

sentences.text: A crowd gathered at once and stared at the little dog.
sentences.textCn: 人群立刻围了上来，盯着那只小狗。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Officer Leo walked past the stalls in a dark new coat, and puffed out his chest.
sentences.textCn: 利奥警官穿着一件深色新大衣走过摊位，得意地挺起胸膛。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: "I will get rid of that dog," he said, and pulled off his coat.
sentences.textCn: “我会处理掉那只狗，”他说着，脱下了大衣。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: "A dog like that is a danger to everyone," he said.
sentences.textCn: “那样的狗对所有人都是危险，”他说。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: "Take it away and punish it at once," he ordered.
sentences.textCn: “把它带走，立刻严惩，”他命令道。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: A voice in the crowd called, "It looks like the General's dog."
sentences.textCn: 人群里有个声音喊道：“那看起来像是将军的狗。”
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The colour drained from the officer's face.
sentences.textCn: 警官脸上的血色褪去。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: He put his coat back on and said, "The carpenter cut himself."
sentences.textCn: 他重新穿上大衣，说：“是木匠自己划伤的。”
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: "You cut your own finger," the officer said.
sentences.textCn: “是你自己划伤了手指，”警官说。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: "Do not blame the poor little dog," he added.
sentences.textCn: “别怪那只可怜的小狗，”他补充道。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: Just then, the General's cook came through the crowd.
sentences.textCn: 就在这时，将军家的厨师从人群中走了出来。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The cook looked at the dog and said, "The General has no such dog."
sentences.textCn: 厨师看了看狗，说：“将军家没有这样的狗。”
sentences.speaker: cook

sentences.text: The officer's smile disappeared, and he pulled off his coat again.
sentences.textCn: 警官的笑容消失了，他又一次脱下了大衣。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: "This is a bad little animal," he said.
sentences.textCn: “这是一只坏畜生，”他说。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: "It should be caught and thrown out," he added.
sentences.textCn: “应该把它抓起来扔出去，”他补充道。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: The cook raised a hand and said, "Wait. This is the dog of the General's visiting brother."
sentences.textCn: 厨师抬起手说：“等等。这是将军来访的哥哥的狗。”
sentences.speaker: cook

sentences.text: The officer's face changed at once, and a wide smile appeared.
sentences.textCn: 警官的脸色立刻变了，脸上堆起了大大的笑容。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: "A dear little dog like this must be protected," he said, and picked it up.
sentences.textCn: “这样可爱的小狗必须好好保护，”他说着，把它抱了起来。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: "Next time, watch your step," he told the carpenter.
sentences.textCn: “下次，小心点，”他对木匠说。
sentences.speaker: leo

sentences.text: He buttoned his coat, put the little dog under his arm, and walked away.
sentences.textCn: 他扣好大衣，把小狗夹在胳膊下，转身走开了。
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The carpenter stood alone in the square with his bleeding finger.
sentences.textCn: 木匠独自站在广场上，手指还在流血。
sentences.speaker: narrator
